whoosh-in.use: Fly in: builds and lands on the moment. For something arriving: a zoom in, a caption or emoji entering.
whoosh-in.credit: "Backwards Whoosh" by SlavicMagic (Freesound), trimmed and levelled

whoosh-out.use: Fly out: starts on the moment and trails away. For something leaving: a zoom back out, a cut away.
whoosh-out.credit: "Whoosh Bamboo 2" by Sadiquecat (Freesound), trimmed and levelled

whoosh.use: Pass-by whoosh, even on both sides. For a cut between two thoughts or a quick move across the frame.
whoosh.credit: "Space Swoosh - brighter" by GameAudio (Freesound), trimmed and levelled

whoosh-fast.use: Short sharp swipe. For a hard punch-in or a fast caption change.
whoosh-fast.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as whoosh.mp3, trimmed and levelled

whoosh-long.use: Slow cinematic sweep, about 2 s in and 2 s out, peaking on the moment. For one big reveal per reel at most.
whoosh-long.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as whoosh-cinematic.mp3, trimmed and levelled

typing.use: Short burst of keys, 1.5 s. For a line of text typing itself on.
typing.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as typing.mp3, trimmed and levelled

typing-long.use: About 4 s of laptop typing. For longer typed text; trim it with "until".
typing-long.credit: "Keyboard Typing Tapping.wav" by Psykophobia (Freesound), trimmed and levelled

typing-mechanical.use: About 7 s of clicky mechanical keyboard. For a coding or terminal moment; trim it with "until".
typing-mechanical.credit: "Kailh Box Pale Blue Mechanical Key" by el_boss (Freesound), trimmed and levelled

key-press.use: One keystroke. For a single word or character landing.
key-press.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as key-press.mp3, trimmed and levelled

pop.use: Quick pop. The default for an emoji or sticker appearing.
pop.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as pop.mp3, trimmed and levelled

click.use: Crisp click. For a button, a tick, a list item appearing.
click.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as click.mp3, trimmed and levelled

ping.use: Sharp electronic ping. For a number or key fact.
ping.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as ping.mp3, trimmed and levelled

chime.use: Soft melodic chime. For a win, a result, a good ending.
chime.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as chime.mp3, trimmed and levelled

notification.use: Message-in tone. For a chat bubble or an alert on screen.
notification.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as notification.mp3, trimmed and levelled

sparkle.use: Bright shimmer. For a before-and-after or a highlight.
sparkle.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as sparkle.mp3, trimmed and levelled

impact.use: Deep bass hit. For the one line that must land hard.
impact.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as impact-bass-1.mp3, trimmed and levelled

riser.use: Rising build of about 2 s that crests on the moment, then rings out. For the run-up to a reveal.
riser.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as riser.mp3, trimmed and levelled

error.use: Wrong-answer tone. For a mistake or a myth being called out.
error.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as error.mp3, trimmed and levelled

glitch.use: Digital glitch. For a jarring cut or a tech moment.
glitch.credit: Pixabay, bundled with HyperFrames as glitch-1.mp3, trimmed and levelled
